problem_statement: to_csv_row() does not quote fields: ['a,b', 'c'] gives 'a,b,c' (three columns), and embedded double quotes are not escaped.
patch:
--- a/datakit_csv/__init__.py
+++ b/datakit_csv/__init__.py
@@ -1,5 +1,12 @@
 """Format one CSV row."""
 
 
+def _quote(value) -> str:
+    text = str(value)
+    if any(ch in text for ch in ',"\n'):
+        text = '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
+    return text
+
+
 def to_csv_row(fields) -> str:
-    return ",".join(str(f) for f in fields)
+    return ",".join(_quote(f) for f in fields)
test_patch:
--- a/tests/test_datakit_csv.py
+++ b/tests/test_datakit_csv.py
@@ -11,3 +11,11 @@
 
 def test_whitespace_is_preserved():
     assert to_csv_row(["a ", " b"]) == "a , b"
+
+
+def test_comma_is_quoted():
+    assert to_csv_row(["a,b", "c"]) == '"a,b",c'
+
+
+def test_quote_is_escaped():
+    assert to_csv_row(['say "hi"']) == '"say ""hi"""'
